title: ID0460076 - [MP / P7 170000762] DC/Si-D/FI - Burnt busbar and insulator
description:
Reported behavior/issue-Burnt busbar and insulator
Solution: Plugit replaced white insulator and Rittal voltage measurement clamp. Contactors not damaged. Busbars cleaned.

additional_info.subject: Original ticket message
additional_info.body:
During contactor change one of the bolts was not tighten enough.
We found out that there has been some sparking between the insulator and bush bar.
We would need help to identified the type/part number of these so we can replace them: See pictures below and in the attachments.
Needed parts to replace:
White insulator - Type and specification needed
Clamp connector/clip - Believed to be used for voltage measurement purposes - Type  and specification needed
Vertical busbar - Is this available to purchase
Connecting busbar - As shown in the referenced image, connects to the vertical busbar
Yellow circle shows the white insulator and clamp connector/clip.
Red shows the parts needed to be replace. We do not have the large fuse, only straight busbar.
